cc:Work.dc:title: SolarWinds and SUNBURST: the key milestones
cc:Work.dc:description: Vertical timeline of twelve SolarWinds SUNBURST milestones from the study's data, colour-coded by phase: covert intrusion and implant (September 2019 to June 2020), discovery and disclosure (December 2020), attribution and policy response (2021), and legal aftermath (2023 to 2025).
